groups.root_cause: Status derivation ignores the run's confirmed-merge flag, so merged PRs are still reported as needing review.
The digest treats an acknowledged approval as final and never checks for later PR head updates that make the approval stale.
The digest does not exclude PRs whose requested-changes repair round is still queued or running.
When the private-strings policy fails to load, limitless_status falls back to a response that drops the state and nextAction fields.
Status checks for a historical landing block before checking closed or resolved states, so a stale block wins over the current state.
The digest treats a missing PR head snapshot as a mismatch with the approval, so an approved PR shows up again as awaiting review.
Digest lines are not truncated, so untrusted run text of any length gets injected into agent context.
A new test assertion is not formatted, which fails the required format check.
In status derivation, an approval takes priority over an active review or repair round and hides the ongoing work.
The Codex skill documentation tells Codex to run the digest command with the 'claude' feed consumer instead of its own.
getRunDetail runs the latest-approval query twice when one query would do.
MCP review verdicts use a hardcoded reviewer value of "human" instead of identifying the agent.
